scope: Independent read-only source review; reviewer did not execute runtime tests or change sources. Root records returned findings.
findings: Baseline status was hover-only, hidden on narrow screens and could falsely imply ongoing connection.
Startup could replace a newer page or new session after held health completed. Added shell/account/view ownership, including post-await Overview guard.
Pre-auth Check is disabled until its binder owns it; account auto-margin keeps wrapped menu on screen.
Existing health GET, API contracts and permissions retained; no further bounded source blocker reported.
limits: Not comprehensive all-control certification. Existing request timeout remains; dismissed requests may finish but cannot alter disposed UI.
